items.title: 落地 browser screenshot smoke 脚本与 npm 入口
items.context: 使用 executeBrowserCases 对最小临时 canvas 项目做黑盒验证，断言会生成有效 png，并把这条入口挂进 package.json。不要扩成整套 browser framework 重构。

happy.desc: browser screenshot smoke 脚本在当前环境里能通过 executeBrowserCases 生成有效 png，并输出 verified 结果。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/browser-screenshot-smoke.json:4 WHY test_story proved the smoke script can drive executeBrowserCases to generate a real PNG file in the current environment. severity=low

edge.desc: 脚本会明确使用 canvas 页面做截图验证，避免把整页 html2canvas 能力误算进 smoke 范围。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/browser-screenshot-smoke.json:19 WHY test_story proved the smoke explicitly validates the canvas screenshot path, not an implicit html2canvas fallback. severity=low

adversarial.desc: 如果浏览器环境不可用，脚本会给出清晰环境失败，而不是伪装成功。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/browser-screenshot-smoke.json:35 WHY test_story proved the broken-environment probe reports a browser-environment category instead of falsely claiming screenshot success. severity=medium

items.title: 补最小 fixture/验证闭环并留收尾总结
items.context: 给这条 smoke 挂上 story 内可重复执行的验证闭环，确认它不是一次性手工探测。完成后在总结里明确：当前证明的是 canvas screenshot 路径，不是通用整页 html2canvas 能力。

happy.desc: 这条 smoke 会有仓库内可重复运行的入口，不再需要临时手写脚本重验。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/browser-screenshot-smoke.json:51 WHY the npm entry is repeatable and returns the expected verified marker, so the smoke is no longer one-off. severity=low

edge.desc: 最小 fixture/验证闭环会直接调用正式脚本入口，而不是依赖当前对话里的临时上下文。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/browser-screenshot-smoke.json:66 WHY direct script invocation works outside fixture context, proving the smoke is a standalone repo entry. severity=low

adversarial.desc: 如果未来 screenshot 链路断在 bridge、浏览器连接或 png 落盘，回归会失败并暴露出来。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/browser-screenshot-smoke.json:81 WHY the broken-env regression probe will fail loudly if screenshot chain or environment classification regresses in the future. severity=medium
